detail:
- **Documented**: 9 of 9 modules carry an author's summary

1 requirement: 1 refuted.
label: foundations
quotes: The Breakpoints module defines a UI component for displaying or managing breakpoints, with no further behavioral detail available from the current declarations.
Color primitives module defines the foundational color constants or utilities used as a shared visual building block across the UI.
Documents the Color swatch module, a single-component UI module for rendering a color preview element.
Documented the Image library module as a UI component for browsing and selecting images from a stored collection.
Documented the Measure table module as a UI component that renders a tabular view of measures, based on minimal available declaration data.
The Radius samples module provides the RadiusSamples component, with no further requirements recorded yet.
Semantic colors module defines named semantic color tokens used to apply consistent, purpose-driven theming across the UI.
A module providing a reference display of typographic styles used across the UI.
The useTokenValue module is a shared React hook that resolves a design token into its concrete rendered value for consumption by foundation display components.
